description:
Remove the Cloudflare Access application (and its policy) for `hostname` - part
    of tearing a staging site down. PREFERRED credential path: save the token to a file
    (chmod 600) and pass token_file=<path> - the path is safe in chat, the secret is not.
    (Also: ZX_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE / ZX_CF_TOKEN_FILE env paths, or ZX_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN /
    ZX_CF_TOKEN raw values.) token=… inline works but hits the transcript; never echoed.
    The app lives in YOUR account - pass account_id=… (or ZX_CF_ACCOUNT_ID). Idempotent:
    a no-op if no app exists. dry_run shows the intent.
name: access_app_delete
